## ✨ OptiFabric

**OptiFabric** is a modern Fabric replacement for OptiFine, bringing OptiFine-like features, shader support, resource pack compatibility, and better optimization for higher FPS and smoother gameplay.

---

## 🚀 Main Benefits

| Feature                         | Description                                                                                |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ⚡ **Higher FPS**                | Improves overall game performance and responsiveness.                                      |
| 💾 **Lower RAM Usage**          | Reduces memory usage and unnecessary system load.                                          |
| 🌅 **Shader Support**           | Allows using shaders on Fabric.                                                            |
| 🧱 **Rendering Optimization**   | Optimizes blocks, entities, chunks, and visual effects.                                    |
| 👀 **Smart Culling**            | Stops rendering blocks and entities that are not visible to the player.                    |
| 🌐 **Server Ping Optimization** | Improves multiplayer server list pinging and makes refreshing servers faster and smoother. |
| 🛡️ **Background Optimization** | Lowers resource usage when Minecraft is minimized.                                         |

---
